title: Love in the Time of War

sentences.text: Anna lived in a small village.
The village was quiet and peaceful.
They said there was a war.
Anna's brother, Tom, had to go and fight.
She did not want Tom to go.
In the village, there was a young man named Jack.
They often talked and laughed together.
Jack also had to go and fight.
He promised Anna he would come back.
She gave him a small locket.
Jack nodded and put the locket around his neck.
Many soldiers did not come back.
She read the letter many times.
He said it was very hard, but he was strong.
He said he thought of Anna every day.
The war was still going on.
She helped the old and the sick.
She was very busy, but she always thought of Jack.
She kept his letters in a box.
She read them when she felt sad.
One evening, there was a knock on the door.
He was tired and dirty, but he was alive.
Jack smiled and showed her the locket.
He had kept it safe all this time.
The war was not over, but Jack was home.
Anna and Jack knew they had to be strong.
They would face the future together.
They had love, and that was enough.
